note: Williams County park at Blacktail Dam, about 25 mi north of Williston, rebuilt under the county's parks master plan and reopened for 2026. Electric/water sites in a paved block by the comfort station and playground, more sites along the shore on the east side and around the west point, a group-site loop, and primitive sites that allow RVs. Boat ramp, fishing pier, kayak launch, beach, trails and a 9-hole par-3 course. Construction continues through 2026: the lower camping area and the north beach stay closed. --Claude
summary: County campground reopened May 21, 2026 after renovation; $10 primitive (RV ok) / $20 E-W (20/30/50) / $25 FHU site 13 / $80 group; bookmysites online booking required May-Sept, 13-night max; 5 of ~28 sites seasonal by lottery. Fees/booking/hookups/facilities written. Pin ok. Waterfront lead: lakefront (sites 14-19 and 20-25 at ~20-45 m over open ground). Algal-bloom advisory and water-off notices flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade): stored lakeview -> lakefront. On the county's May-2026 aerial map (scale bar 300 ft = 230 px, ~0.40 m/px) the east row, sites 14-19, sits between the camp lane and the lake with only open gravel/grass and a walking trail between pads and the riprap shore: site 14 ~36 m, 15 ~45 m, 16 ~38 m, 17 ~30 m, 18 ~26 m, 19 ~20 m to the water (roughly 48.4294,-103.7346 for site 14 to 48.4301,-103.7359 for site 19, scaled from the map). The west point, sites 20-25, is ringed by water over mown grass and shoreline shrubs: 20 ~34 m, 21 ~36 m, 22 ~44 m (north shore), 23-25 ~26-28 m (west shore) (around 48.4295,-103.7385, scaled from the map). Sold nightly: all sites are online-bookable except five seasonal lottery sites whose numbers the county does not publish, so at least one of 14-19 and most of 20-25 are nightly. Esri imagery predates the rebuild, so these distances rest on the county's own aerial map with icon positions, not pad outlines; worth a re-look when Esri updates. Not an --AWH value.

SEASONAL SHARE: five seasonal lottery sites ($1,900, May 29 - Oct 1, 2026) out of 28 numbered individual sites plus 4 group and 5 primitive sites; mostly nightly. 'Only campers and RVs are allowed to park on the site for the duration of the season'.

ADVISORIES (not a status): 'Note: Water is shut off for the remainder of 2026.' and '9/8/2026: The ND Department of Environmental Quality (NDDEQ) has issued a Harmful Algal Bloom ADVISORY for the lake at Blacktail Dam.' The 2026 map marks the 'Lower camping area closed for construction in 2026' and the 'North Beach area closed for construction in 2026'; 'Construction at Blacktail Dam ... will continue through 2026.'
